The '''Sevarin Mesa''' was a stone mesa on the eastern edge of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was the western wall of the [[Shattered Basin]]. A [[Sevarin Mesa Windfarms|windfarming]] complex was built in the basin, with windfarms located along the top of the mesa.
